title: Recent sessions (detail)
sqlTemplate: select _timestamp, session_id, view_url, user_agent_user_agent_family, user_agent_os_family from _rumdata where service = {{service}} and env = {{environment}}{{version_clause}} and type = 'view' order by _timestamp desc limit 50
emptyDataSemantics: No matching view records -> an empty result set (zero rows). session_id/view_url are high-cardinality fields shown only as a bounded (LIMIT 50, most-recent-first) list, never grouped/aggregated on. A session with multiple page views appears as multiple rows (one per view event) by design, exactly like recent-errors-detail's own session_id list column — this is a recent-activity feed for finding a session_id to paste into Session Investigation, not a deduplicated session count (see sessions_count for that number). Sourced only from _rumdata: no dependency on _sessionreplay/Session Replay, which remains fully disabled (docs/session-replay-security-decision.md).
